narrative.overview: The latest owner screenshot establishes minimal white listings and a pale-grey shared sidebar: compact corners, fine borders, quiet metadata and black listing actions. This 14 October refinement overrides the earlier cream/red direction for the listing view and shared shell. Training and fictional guest tests retain red controls and 24px panels, inside the updated shell. Existing code and real saved data/functions remain the basis; the website and guest sandbox keep their separate guidance below.
keyCharacteristics: White listings and a pale-grey shared sidebar.
Visible labels and readable saved facts.
Black listing actions and compact corners; retained red training/test controls.

rules.name: The Labelled State Rule
rules.body: Selection, progress and document outcomes must remain understandable without colour.

dos: Do use the existing saved data and protected functions for every working screen.
Do preserve visible navigation labels, keyboard focus and draft retention.
Do keep website, sandbox and dashboard values scoped to their own surfaces.
donts: Don't imply photos, production Check-ins or One Inbox screens exist.
Don't treat a name check or a host decision as government verification.
